name: parse stack traces from a text log into frames
definition: Separate a log into individual stack traces and split the innermost frame lines, cleaning any frame prefix tokens, so each frame maps to one call site string.
failure_mode: Mispresheet of trace boundaries yield wrong trace/frame counts.

name: parse tool-path commands to reconstruct drawn geometry
definition: interpret a printer tool-path file by reading movement and plunge commands so the intended shapes are recovered.
failure_mode: incorrect tool-path interpretation produces the wrong shapes or text.
